I fixed the bug in `ledger/currency.py`. All 5 tests now pass, including the 4 in `tests/test_totals.py`.

`to_cents` used `int(amount * 100)`, which truncates. Float error makes `19.99 * 100` come out as 1998.9999…, so it returned 1998 instead of 1999. It now uses `int(round(amount * 100))`.
